ICD changelog

What each release of the model (core/coordination/delta-graph.icd.json) added, changed, retired or renamed, for the people building on the Community API. Newest first. The release is its icd/* tag and pin; the lists between the markers are computed from the released files by icd-changelog.mjs, and --check refuses them if they differ. Method: deploy.md § 10.

Every op is written the same way: POST /v2/apply with {object, op, args} on an object that exists, or POST /v2/mint to make one. GET /v2/icd serves the model production runs; model.html lists every op and its args.

2.10.0

  • Draft (media.hosted and facets.exterior.fields, the hosted exterior), from 75f0272; its ICD 806f3d921bea360fb8e91d84eea068e37249882fe225da8434f3c3b2de7d01e1, not a release until its icd/* tag
  • Against 2.9.0 (f5bb181cf7f7a2df…):
  • changed: base.setExterior: +hostedKey (string); +hostedSecret (string); +precision (integer); +readableOutside (integer)
  • model sections changed besides ops: facets, media

The hosted exterior: an object's outside, whole, at one key in the relay's object storage, overwritten in place by its owner's devices, so a change reaches every reader without being carried again (media.hosted). What it holds of each kind is facets.exterior.fields: for an Event its when, its Place at a geohash precision its owner sets, its hosts, lineup, media, tickets and how many are going; for a Post its teaser, and its body only when its poster says. base.setExterior gains precision, readableOutside, hostedKey and hostedSecret: the pointer. A new relay frame, media_host at vocabulary level 4, asks for the overwrite, signed by the object's own key. There is no Community API route for it in this release.

2.9.0

  • Draft (the media facet, base.setIcon and base.setBanner, #112), from 493c259; its ICD f5bb181cf7f7a2df7f55b1d0a17186b1ecca2b0a47c484eca965df7e2fd4dbfb, not a release until its icd/* tag
  • Against 2.8.0 (0eae9b116066add8…):
  • added: base.setBanner (facet media, op 4027514881, owner|role:admin, commutative)
  • added: base.setIcon (facet media, op 4027514880, owner|role:admin, commutative)
  • model sections changed besides ops: facets

The media facet (#112): base.setIcon and base.setBanner give every group, event, thing and post an icon and a banner, each a detached media reference (media.detached). The owner or an admin writes them; the last writer by (gen, author) holds. Where written, they win over a kind's own picture, which stays readable for what was made before.

2.8.0

  • Release: icd/2.8.0, 2026-11-11; the pin 0eae9b116066add834ade9e18d4f66c298cc9fd872dd05b7bcb960a5423daff0
  • Against 2.7.0 (a9eac5c92bf6f0a4…):
  • changed: group.publishListing: +createdAt (integer)
  • model sections changed besides ops: mls

When an object was made (#58): mls.groupContextExtensions.createdAt, the time in the object's MLS GroupContext, set when it is created and never changed, by its creator's clock. GET /v2/graph gives each object's createdAt (absent for one made before this release). group.publishListing takes an optional createdAt, the Thing's, so a Site listing says when its Thing was made.

2.7.0

  • Release: icd/2.7.0, 2026-11-11; the pin a9eac5c92bf6f0a484a33f526170c94df20d11109f4b6d436746334bcbe2f7e0
  • Against 2.6.0 (2c1067380ed4d2e2…):
  • model sections changed besides ops: media

Detached media (#56): media.detached states how a media object outside the Delta is sealed and read, so that any implementation opens what another wrote. XChaCha20-Poly1305 under a fresh content key, the object key as AAD, the digest over the stored object, uploads create-only, fetched by key alone. No op changes: every media op's <p>Secret already carried the content key; it now says how the bytes are sealed with it. A site uploads media through WallFlowers' app; there is no Community API route for it in this release.

2.6.0

  • Release: icd/2.6.0, 2026-11-09; the pin 2c1067380ed4d2e2ab6f7b2350994c5957f47ef745b4c866cfb154df0ad7bc85
  • Against 2.5.0 (5e51f052ad216850…):
  • added: base.decideRequest (facet exterior, op 4027449346, owner|role:admitter, commutative)
  • added: base.setDoor (facet exterior, op 4027449345, owner, sequenced)
  • added: base.setExterior (facet exterior, op 4027449344, owner, sequenced)
  • added: contact.publishExterior (contact, op 13, member, commutative)
  • added: group.setRequest (group, op 23, owner, sequenced)
  • model sections changed besides ops: facets, legs, mls

The exterior of a GroupObject (#76): what a non-member holds of an object, and a way to ask to join. facets.exterior (base.setExterior, base.setDoor, base.decideRequest) on every kind that has one, carried to non-members by contact.publishExterior as far as base.setVisibility says, and asked through mls.door, a request sealed to the door's key. Not open to a site in this release: WallFlowers' iOS app writes an exterior, carries it and answers its door. Deprecated, each linking its new route: contact.publishListing, contact.invite, contact.discoverRequest/Response, place.setDoorbell.

Departures: base.claimSpent's ego, released as member, is owner|role:admitter: what the fold already enforced (NC-135). Named in the pin's W- row.

For sites (W-98; each lands with its lane, and its docs page when the release ships):

  • Rooms: a room's description, forum.editDescription; deleting your post, forum.retract (2.1.0). rooms.html.
  • Events: lineup, banner, photos, clip, event.editProfile; RSVP and registration, group.rsvp, group.setRegistration, group.rsvpDecide. public.html.
  • Resources: documents and their assets, post.setDocument, post.addAsset, post.removeAsset. public.html.
  • Members: an about text and the owner's questions, base.publishAbout, base.defineQuestion, base.answerQuestion, base.retireQuestion; links between members, contact.setLink. members.html.
  • Trade: listings, group.publishListing, group.removeListing, thing.*; a deal's life, transaction.setTerms through transaction.rate. Its page comes with the Trade lane.
